tools.name: voyant_get_context
tools.description: Get full marketing context for content generation. Returns personas, products, messaging, positioning, and context streams.

tools.name: voyant_get_modulated_context
tools.description: Get persona/funnel-modulated context. Shape the context based on a specific persona and/or funnel stage.

persona_id.description: Persona ID to modulate context for

funnel_stage.description: Funnel stage to shape content for

tools.name: voyant_search
tools.description: Semantic search across the knowledge base using RAG. Returns relevant content chunks.

tools.name: voyant_list_streams
tools.description: List all available context streams for the organization.

tools.name: voyant_get_personas
tools.description: Get all target personas defined in the messaging framework.

tools.name: voyant_get_products
tools.description: Get all products defined in the messaging framework.

tools.name: voyant_get_positioning
tools.description: Get brand positioning framework (value proposition, differentiators, etc.).

tools.name: voyant_get_messaging
tools.description: Get messaging framework (elevator pitch, headlines, tone, etc.).

tools.name: voyant_get_use_cases
tools.description: Get use cases defined in the messaging framework.

tools.name: voyant_get_industries
tools.description: Get target industries defined in the messaging framework.

tools.name: voyant_generate_content
tools.description: Generate content using RAG context and messaging framework. Returns AI-generated content for the specified platform.

query.description: Topic or prompt for content generation

tools.name: voyant_get_signals
tools.description: Get market signals from various sources (GitHub, Reddit, HackerNews, etc.).

days.description: Number of days to look back (default: 7)

tools.name: voyant_get_rag_stats
tools.description: Get RAG system statistics and readiness status.

methods.description: Voyant API key - generate in Settings > Integrations

authentication.recommendation: Use API keys (vio_*) for agent integrations. Generate keys in the Voyant UI under Settings > Integrations.
